messages:
Sam: Morning shift handover — quick update before I log off. Key changes since my shift:
- Prefetch job merged (PR #1429) to warm KV cache for common prefixes. Expect fewer cold starts but a ~200ms bump in bg job CPU during low traffic windows.
- Canary rollout of model v2-optimized to 2% capacity in us-west1. No errors so far.
- Small infra config tweak: autoscaler threshold lowered from 70% -> 65% for serving-pool-prod (to be conservative).
Watchlist / risks:
- Cache warmup: watch prefetch job failures (s3->cache copy). If failing, fallback to on-demand cold starts and latency spikes.
- Canary errors: if 5%+ 5xx for 5m, rollback.
- Customer-eta spike: we saw a burst from corp-x yesterday; keep an eye on token qps.
Action items for next shift:
- Maria: monitor prefetch logs and alert on >3 consecutive failures (:eyes:).
- Olivia: check canary dashboard on rollout health and confirm no model drift in the first 30m.
- TJ: hold off any manual scale-ups unless end-to-end latency > 600ms for >2m.
Please ack and ask questions. I left the runbook link in the thread: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefetch-and-canary

Maria: Acked. I'll tail the prefetch logs for the next 90m. Which log group is preferred?

Sam: Use `prefetch-worker-prod` in CloudLogs. Quick tail: `gcloud logging read "logName=projects/redwood/logs/prefetch-worker-prod" --project=redwood --limit=50 --order=desc`

Maria: Got it, thanks. If I see >3 failures I'll escalate and post error snippets here.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot reported: Canaries started for model v2-optimized in us-west1 at 1968504380. 2% traffic -> 2 instances. Monitoring enabled.

Olivia: I'll look at canary charts in the console now. Saw a small spike in 5xx about 30m ago but it correlated with a customer import job. Will verify model outputs on a few prod prompts.

TJ: FYI I'll be heavy on calls between 21:00-22:00 UTC. Can someone cover the 21:30-22:00 check-in tomorrow? I'm happy to swap another day.

Sam: @TJ noted. @Olivia / @Maria can you cover the 21:30 quick check tomorrow? (should be 10m)

Olivia: I can take the 21:30 check tomorrow.

Maria: I can backup if needed.

Sam: Thanks all. Two small troubleshooting notes before I go:
- If prefetch writes fail with `EACCES` the node IAM role may have rotated; check IAM audit and restart prefetch-worker pod.
- If canary latency increases but error rate is low, temporarily bump canary CPU limit +10% to see effect, then revert.

Maria: Quick question — where do we post canary rollback decisions? Slack channel or the incident runbook?

Sam: Post here for visibility and update the runbook with a short note. If rollback is triggered automatically by the monitor, oncall-bot will post a message; manual rollbacks should be documented in the runbook ticket.

deploy-bot: Canary health OK at 1968504520 — 0.3% 5xx over last 10m, latency stable.

Olivia: Checked models with 6 sample prompts — outputs look consistent vs baseline. No sign of semantic drift.

Maria: Prefetch logs look healthy. One transient S3 500 around 1968504450 but retries recovered. Will keep tailing.

TJ: Thanks — swapping coverage noted. I'll DM Sam to arrange a different swap date for my 21:30 slot.

Sam: All good. I pushed a tiny doc update to the runbook: note about IAM rotation and prefetch restart steps. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefetch-and-canary#iam-rotation

Olivia: 👍  leaving a :thumbsup: on that.

Sam: Signing off. If anything pops, ping me and I'll jump in.
